Let \(P=(t^2,4t)\). Since \(F=(4,0)\),

\[
|PF|=\sqrt{(t^2-4)^2+(4t)^2}=t^2+4.
\]

Also,

\[
|PA|=\sqrt{(t^2-1)^2+(4t-2)^2}.
\]

So minimize

\[
S(t)=t^2+4+\sqrt{(t^2-1)^2+(4t-2)^2}.
\]

Setting \(S'(t)=0\):

\[
2t+\frac{2t^3+14t-8}{\sqrt{(t^2-1)^2+(4t-2)^2}}=0,
\]

which has the valid critical point \(t=\frac12\). Thus

\[
S\left(\frac12\right)=\frac14+4+\sqrt{\left(-\frac34\right)^2+0^2}
=\frac{17}{4}+\frac34=5.
\]

Therefore, the minimum value is

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
